techStack: React 19, TypeScript 5.7, Vite 6 — ES modules, no path aliases, relative imports only
Vitest 3 + @testing-library/react 16 + jsdom 26 — test environment, not Jest
TypeScript strict mode: noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch
Tests live in /tests/ directory as *.test.tsx — must not be modified
Global fetch is stubbed in tests/setup.ts to return all 15 products from src/data/products.ts
features: BUG 1 — productFilters.ts lines ~13-20: sort block runs first, before any filter step; must move to after all result.filter() calls
BUG 2 — productFilters.ts line ~22: search uses product.name.includes(filters.search) with no .toLowerCase() and no .trim(); also if (filters.search) does not strip whitespace-only strings
BUG 3 — FilterPanel.tsx lines ~67-75: clear button onChange omits sortBy: 'default'; resets only search/category/inStockOnly
useProductFilters.ts initialFilters already has correct defaults (sortBy: 'default') — no change needed
FilterState type has sortBy: 'default' | 'price-asc' | 'price-desc' | 'rating-desc' — already correct
Category, inStockOnly filter steps in productFilters.ts are already correct — must not be changed
architecture: Data flow: productsApi.ts (fetch) → useProductFilters hook (state) → App.tsx useMemo(filterProducts(products, filters)) → ProductList render
FilterPanel accepts filters: FilterState and onChange callback; calls onChange with spread of filters plus overrides
SortSelect is a separate component; its onChange also calls setFilters — not involved in the three bugs
FilterState and filterProducts are co-located in src/utils/productFilters.ts
Product type is in src/types/product.ts — name, category, price, inStock, rating fields are the ones used by filters
All three bugs are self-contained in exactly two files: productFilters.ts (BUG 1 + BUG 2) and FilterPanel.tsx (BUG 3)
edgeCases: Whitespace-only search ('   '): filters.search is truthy so the current guard passes it through; after .trim() it becomes '' and must not filter — guard must check filters.search.trim(), not filters.search
Sort with no active filters: sort operates on full 15-product set — no special handling needed once sort is last
Sort combined with active filter: sort must see only the already-filtered subset — guaranteed by moving sort block after all filter steps
Combined category + inStockOnly: AND semantics already work because each step filters result sequentially — no change needed
Clear while sort is active: sortBy must reset to 'default' — covered entirely by BUG 3 fix
Sorting must not mutate products argument: let result = [...products] already exists — no change needed there

tasks.requirement: Requirements 1, 2, 3 — search is case-insensitive, trims whitespace, matches product.name only
tasks.description: In productFilters.ts, fix the search filter block: change the guard from `if (filters.search)` to `if (filters.search.trim())`, and change the match from `product.name.includes(filters.search)` to `product.name.toLowerCase().includes(filters.search.trim().toLowerCase())`

tasks.requirement: Requirements 8, 9 — sorting applied after all filter steps, does not mutate source array
tasks.description: In productFilters.ts, move the entire sort block (the if/else if chain for sortBy) to after all result.filter() calls — it must be the last operation before `return result`. The `let result = [...products]` copy already exists so mutation is not an issue; only the position of the sort block needs to change.

tasks.requirement: Requirement 14 — Clear filters resets all four fields including sortBy
